item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Patches `litellm.responses`, instantiates `dspy.LM(..., model_type=\"responses\")`, and calls `lm.forward(...)`, so the captured kwargs are the post-conversion outbound Responses request."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Configures `openai/gpt-5` with `model_type=\"responses\"`, `reasoning_effort=\"low\"`, `temperature=1.0`, and `max_tokens=16000` before sending the prompt."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts `reasoning_effort` is absent from the captured call and that `reasoning` equals `{\"effort\": \"low\", \"summary\": \"auto\"}`."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Prints the captured `input` field from the Responses request, which surfaces the converted Responses payload rather than a chat-style `messages` payload."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
